manual_notes: Leader election is backed by the Redis lock provider: first acquisition sets primary, followers retry, lease renewal failure demotes, and standalone bypasses election and reports primary. Scheduled master-only execution checks the shared primary state before running, while all-node jobs pass that gate. This corroborates delivery without claiming that a multi-node failover test was run during annotation.

sources.observed_facts: One topology interface owns enabled mode, primary state and node ID; election is constructed internally only for cluster mode with a lock provider.
Fixed leader-election lock, node holder and lease, follower retry ticker, acquisition state and lease-stop demotion are implemented.
Lease renewal failure logs a warning with context and ends the lease worker, notifying election state to demote.
SETNX with TTL acquires a token-bearing handle; owner-check Lua renew/release prevents old holders deleting a new lock; INCR provides fencing tokens.
Scheduled master-only jobs return before execution on followers; the scheduler records a skipped-not-primary diagnostic.
Scheduler primary and node identity queries delegate to the injected cluster service.
